head: 8be326e

findings.what: The reverse guard test_clean_rotated_chart_page_keeps_the_chart_asset_lane exercises a clean rotated CAPTION fixture, not a chart page with axis tick labels. The tick-label false-positive case (Pflueger-Rinaldi p37, 67/95 short lines, sound) is covered only by the author's 27-paper corpus sweep, which is not reproducible from the repo without the reference PDFs.
findings.why: The false-positive risk the brief flags is specifically a rotated CHART page whose tick labels the geometric predicate might read as shredding. The unit test does not construct that geometry; it relies on the corpus sweep. I independently built a rotated chart page with tick labels spaced 40pt apart and confirmed rotated_text_is_shredded returns False, so the predicate is sound on that geometry, but the regression suite does not pin it.

findings.what: On the chart lane, the floor ships the chart lane's own PNG ref, which is labelled '![Chart page 1](...)' while the floor marker reads 'rotated text extraction shredded — see image'. The image is the full page (rendered by _render_chart_page_png), so a human can still read the caption, but the label is slightly misleading for a page whose text half was refused.
findings.why: Cosmetic only; the image content is correct (full page). Not a correctness or surfacing defect.

what_i_tried_to_break: 1) Enumerated every engine label literal in src/ that can be a passing best_output shipping native_text: 'native', 'native+math', 'chart_asset'. All three are caught by startswith(('native','chart_asset')) — 'native+math' via the 'native' prefix. 'chart_region' and 'llm-merged' are audit-event/consensus labels, never a native-text winner. No fourth lane. 2) Drove the deterministic (agentic=False) path on the shredded fixture with and without --native-only: both ship doc status 'failed'/'error', zero confetti — the floor is reached, not bypassed. 3) Re-ran the new test file at the round-1 head 220e00d (2 chart-lane tests fail, 12 pass) and at the true base 8ad92e1 (4 fail, 10 pass), confirming non-vacuity on both rounds and that the reverse guards pass on both sides. 4) Built a rotated chart page with axis tick labels and confirmed rotated_text_is_shredded returns False (no false positive on tick geometry). 5) Confirmed the resume asymmetry is sound: native_rotated_text_shredded is re-derived by apply_born_digital in _phase_analyze on every process() call, while rotated_shred_png_ref (a loop side-effect) is restored in _restore_terminal_page_state. 6) Verified no multiset/Counter oracle in the fix and no numeric threshold in rotated_text_is_shredded (glyph height and separation are page-derived). 7) Confirmed test_landscape_refusal_a2_gh147.py passes in full (8 passed) and is not in the changed-files list.
